# Feature: World profile item-catalog module

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-06 — issue #142 -->

## Intent

World profiles gain a stable `item-catalog` module that selects which built-in packs and individual definitions a world offers by default. Scope/ownership stay separate from availability. Pure deterministic resolver prepares the catalog for Character Inventory (#143).

## Preconditions

- World profiles store modules as JSONB behind a registry with stable module IDs.
- Built-in packs from #137 exist (`builtin-standard` Fantasy/Sci-Fi/Contemporary + context packs).
- Core 36 archetypes remain universally visible and cannot be disabled by this module.

## Happy Path

- [ ] World module ID `item-catalog` persists config: `enabledPackIds`, `includedDefinitionIds`, `excludedDefinitionIds`, `allowPersonalItems` (default `true`).
- [ ] Pure resolver: union pack definitions → add includes → remove excludes → add world-scoped defs → personal if allowed; dedupe by stable definition id; Core always present.
- [ ] World editor section `Gegenstände & Ausrüstung` toggles base/context packs, search-add includes, list includes/excludes with remove, and `allowPersonalItems` toggle with immediate feedback.
- [ ] Unknown pack/definition IDs preserved or fail-safe ignored with diagnosis — older clients must not destroy newer profiles.
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Empty packs → Core-only (+ world defs + personal per flag).
- [ ] Exclude of Core id is ignored (Core cannot be deactivated).
- [ ] Include already in pack → still listed as explicit include without duplicate in effective set.
- [ ] Invalid module shape → defaults / diagnosis, never crash editor save of other modules.

## Regression

- [ ] Existing world modules unchanged.
- [ ] Inventory effectiveWorldProfileId resolution unchanged until #143 wires consumption.
- [ ] Item packs (#137) and workbench (#139–#141) unchanged.

## Assumptions

- Availability ≠ ownership: enabling a pack does not change definition scope.
- #143 will consume the resolver; this ticket ships resolver + editor + persistence only.
